title: Env+
description: A mod who ads some structure and biomes. IN BETA
body:
Env+ is a minecraft mod by Twent Games who disposes of new biomes and structure for improve your in-game experience.
All biomes:
- Yellow Birch Forest
- Gray Plain
- Candy Biome (Candy Cane)


All features:
- Sugar rafinery and Caramel


All Structures:
- Antic Wall
- Antic Tomb
- Antic Pillar
- Plain House
- 4 New spawners
